d: Bihar ke navada jile ke charchit aur rongte khare kar dene vale sunil rajak hatyakand men adalat ne aitihasik phaisla sunate hue katil patni sarita devi (Sarita Devi) ko aajivan karavas (umrakaid) ki saja sunaee hai. navada kort ne sarita devi ko bhartiy dand vidhan (IPC) ki dhara 302 ke tahat umrakaid ke sath-sath dhara 201 (sakshy chhipane) men 7 sal ke sashram karavas aur 25 hajar rupye arthadand ki saja bhi sunaee hai.
